scope: C136 FIT 248 maps / original monitor 628 maps, C101 fixed pixels. TRAIN only.
notes: Cache normalized squared-field factors are multiplied by (wavelength/(4 pi))^2 before conversion to PL. All metric accumulation is FP64.
All raw physical metrics use absolute gain, not an anchor that cancels physical errors.
Calibration is one FIT-only dB offset per band, not a scene-wise fit.
Necessary positivity bound is specific to the approximate direct operator, not a law-level contradiction.
Refinement differences are diagnostics, not confidence bounds or exact integration errors.

C132_fixed_point.interpretation_warning: Initial audit replay used L-Q to reconstruct extra power, unlike the original C132 implementation which accumulates positive terms. Cancellation affects weak-power comparisons. Superseded by stable positive/log-domain replay in receiver_convergence.json; do not attribute L-Q artifacts to the original model.
